vedic_reference.note: Rohini is the name of a nakshatra (star) and a wife of Vasudeva. Nandan means 'son of' or 'delight of'.

data.cultural_impact: Rohininandan is a name that resonates deeply within the Hindu community, as it holds significant importance to the legend of Lord Krishna. Lord Krishna, being one of the most beloved deities in Hinduism, is believed to have appeared on this earth multiple times to establish Dharma (righteousness) and to lead humanity towards the path of spiritual growth. Rohini, one of the eight principal wives of Lord Vishnu, is the mother of Lord Krishna's avatar, Balarama. The name "Rohininandan" is a gentle reminder of Lord Krishna's divine descent through his mother Rohini and the eternal love and protection he provides to his devotees.
data.spiritual_significance: Rohininandan carries a profound spiritual significance that transcends time and space. The name itself evokes the image of Lord Krishna, the embodiment of love, compassion, and playfulness. According to Hindu scriptures, Lord Krishna came to this earth to put an end to the onset of moral decay and to reestablish righteousness. As Rohininandan, he remains a beacon of hope and solace to his devotees, providing strength and guidance to help them navigate the intricacies of life. Through his name, the peaceful energy of Lord Krishna is invoked, offering his blessings for personal growth, enlightenment, and the attainment of Moksha (liberation from the cycle of birth and death).

historical_references.reference: Rishi Rohini, also known as Rohiniandan, was a famous sage and an ancestor of Lord Krishna. He is mentioned in the Mahabharata, an ancient Indian epic. Rohini is the name of a constellation, and Rishi Rohini is said to have lived during the Treta Yuga, around 3 million years ago.
